description: This file defines the declaration of the LocalStore class, which implements the ILocalStore interface for managing local data storage using SQLite. It includes method declarations for opening the database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving and removing entries, and adding entries.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that provides local data storage management, implementing methods for database operations such as opening, creating tables, adding, retrieving, and removing data entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database connection at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit for entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a range in a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting at a given position.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve events from a table within a specified range.
